scope: A common lateral rest offset at the proximal-anchored TPU end, not a pose-by-pose imposed shift. Each cap position, orientation and two swivels are solved under cable load and TPU restoring forces. The original folded tendon lead length hypothesis and the same point-bend lower bound remain. Rigid overlaps are checked after the solve; there is no contact force, flexible mesh or support CAD.
